name: Young Nagato (S)
description: The Rain Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to the Hidden Rain Village's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War. Nagato is a quiet boy who is not only afraid of the world, but also afraid of himself.

skills.name: Rinnegan Dominion
skills.description: Nagato awakens his Rinnegan, gaining 20 points of destructible defense. For 1 turn, 'Wind Style: Air Bullets' and 'Amateur Shinra Tensei' will be improved. Each time this skill is used, its duration and cooldown will increase by 1.

skills.name: Wind Style: Air Bullets
skills.description: Nagato shoots multiple bullets of air at one enemy, dealing 25 damage and stunning their skills for 1 turn. During 'Rinnegan Dominion', this skill will deal 100% more damage.

skills.name: Amateur Shinra Tensei
skills.description: By activating Shinra Tensei, Nagato protects one ally. For 1 turn, that ally becomes invulnerable. Afterwards, they will heal 10 health and all harmful skills will be removed from them. During 'Rinnegan Dominion', this skill will cost 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Majestic Frog Disguise
skills.description: This skill makes Young Nagato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.
